decisions.rationale: No Mega on my side. Opponent's Mega is Gengar. Lead Farigiraf+Gholdengo: Mental Herb blocks Taunt, Good as Gold makes Gholdengo immune to Gengar's Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb. Set TR turn 1. Back Azumarill+Rotom-Wash sweep under TR. Gliscor stays benched vs this offensive meta.

Krookodile is Scarf Jolly — slower than my TR sweepers under TR. Dragonite Lum Multiscale but Azumarill Play Rough breaks it. Will-O-Wisp from Rotom cripples physical attackers. Key: set TR turn 1, protect Farigiraf, then sweep.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Mega Gengar. Lead Scarf Krookodile and Gengar to deliver immediate speed and pressure against Gholdengo and Farigiraf. Shadow Tag prevents switches while fast Knock Off/High Horsepower + Shadow Ball removes key TR setters and Gholdengo before Make It Rain or Trick Room starts. Backline Arcanine adds a second Intimidate and Fire pressure; Hydrapple walls Rotom-Wash and Azumarill with Giga Drain and high bulk.

Hydrapple + double Intimidate (Krookodile/Arcanine) handles physical/water threats (Azumarill, Rotom-W, Gliscor).

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gholdengo)

decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Gengar+Krookodile (Scarf Jolly); TR active 4 more turns; Gholdengo Focus Sash vs Gengar Shadow Ball; Krookodile locked into Knock Off; Azumarill breaks Dragonite Multiscale; Rotom-W Wisp for physical attackers.

reflections.summary: Lost due to poor lead choice and burn damage. Opponent's Intimidate leads weakened Azumarill, and a critical miss on Hydro Pump allowed Hydrapple to survive and KO Rotom. Gengar-Mega cleaned up with super-effective Shadow Ball on Gholdengo, whose Focus Sash was already consumed. The Trick Room plan was not executed because Farigiraf came in too late at low HP.
reflections.adjustment: Lead Farigiraf + Gholdengo to set Trick Room immediately. Use Protect on Gholdengo turn 1 to preserve its Sash. Under Trick Room, Gholdengo's slower speed allows it to move before Gengar-Mega and threaten with Shadow Ball. Bring Rotom-Wash in back to Will-O-Wisp Arcanine and Hydrapple, and save Azumarill for late-game cleanup after Intimidate users are removed.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads Krookodile+Arcanine for dual Intimidate; Gengar-Mega enters mid-game; Hydrapple is bulky Regenerator+Leftovers; Arcanine has Will-O-Wisp; all mons except Hydrapple are moderately fast. Plan: use Trick Room with Farigiraf, protect Gholdengo first turn, target Gengar with Shadow Ball, burn key threats with Rotom, avoid physical attackers early due to Intimidate.

reflections.summary: The team preview plan with Mega Gengar and Hydrapple was spot-on, as Shadow Tag trapping paired with Hydrapple completely neutralized Rotom-Wash and Azumarill in the endgame despite Krookodile taking early heavy damage.
